The bard:
How was your expedition to the ruins?

The bard:
The remains of an ancient culture... must be interesting!

The bard:
The Sagestone...wow!

The skilled warrior:
The inexperienced should take no chances in combat...

The skilled warrior:
Without fighting experience one shouldn't explore the north!

The skilled warrior:
The Sagestone? You possess such a treasure? How did you manage that?

The masked man:
I'm relaxing today!

The host:
Ah, you're back already, have you met with some success?
You tell him about your adventures...

The host:
So far you've just found a stone plate...

The host:
However... that thing just might be valuable!

The host:
There's an expert here at the moment, perhaps he can appraise its worth.

The host:
A stone plate...

The host:
You're going to ask me about adventure, I know it!

The host:
So are you planning on searching for the jewels?

The host:
Everyone's a jester... and yes, I have heard of them.

The host:

The host:
A worker who mananged to escape the mine told of a demon, who possessed a scintillating stone!

The host:
This demon supposedly looked like a lizard!

The host:
The mine lies to the north. If you want, you could go there.

The host:
The people also speak of an ancient tower...

The host:
It was built by the Arcane culture for a great wizard who has never been seen.

The host:
The ancient tower is supposedly to the east. This tablet may be proof of its existence...

The host:
Yes, there's more..

The host:
There are supposedly two other places...

The host:
I hear a lot, but I don't trust my fighting skill, so I've never actually been there...

The host:
It is said that an ancient underground crypt lies to the north, haunted by the spirits of the dead...

The host:
If the rumors are true, these ghosts are the souls of the cursed...

The host:
Mere mortals are unwelcomed there.

The host:
There's another mysterious place...

The host:
Many powerful warriors have gone there, but not a single one has returned...

The host:
...the lord of the palace knows the secret of eternal life...

The host:

The host:

Now...

The abandoned mine in the north, the ancient

The host:
Hmmm...

The host:
It is said that there is a secret chamber in the 3rd underlevel of the mine...

The host:
If you don't have any other plans, you could check it out.

The host:
Don't expect too much!

The host:
The demons in those places are especially dangerous, so be careful!

The host:
To bring all of the jewels together..

The host:
If you tell me of your adventures, I'll buy the drinks!

The expert:
Well, still haven't found anything?
Let me take a look...

The expert:
That can't be the...

The expert:
............

The expert:
But that's not possible!

The expert:
Could you hand me that for a second?

The expert:
I have waited for this moment for so long...

The elder:
Hmmm, it looks like the Sagestone...

The elder:
A legendary artifact, created by the twelve wise men of the Arcanes...

The elder:
According to legend this thing brings forth miracles and sets magical energies free.

The elder:
Indeed...

The elder:
It doesn't look quite the same as it does in the books...

The elder:
If I'm not mistaken, there are jewels set in the stone pictured in the books...

The elder:
It seems to be genuine though. Perhaps someone removed the jewels...

The elder:
If you could find the jewels which fit it, that would prove it's authenticity...

:
It would prove?

And with such a discovery you would become a legend.

The elder:
Yes, yes, that would be good... Finally some proof of the rumors...

The elder:
That might be the Sagestone...

Sagestone?

Hmmm... there was once a jewel  here in this notch.

The elder:
Ooooh, yes, it may be this stone!

No doubt, that's the right stone!

The elder:
If you could just find all of the jewels...

The elder:
I don't know, but if you seek them...

The elder:

The elder:

The elder:
Now don't rush, take it slow...

The elder:
According to legend the Stone only holds its power when used by a great hero.

The elder:
If that rumor is true, then you must become stronger in order to use the Sagestone...

The elder:
Great...and what are you planning now?

The elder:
If that rumor is true, then you must become stronger, if you wish to use it...
